item.title: Woodville's first community market is bringing local vendors and fresh produce to a Leon County food desert
item.description: The market is designed to serve as a hub for small and local producers, giving neighbors easier access to support local businesses while encouraging healthier and more affordable living.

item.title: Downtown Bainbridge sees $1.7 million in property sales as local businesses rally behind growth
item.description: Six downtown Bainbridge properties, including Sucheros and Smooth Brewing, sold for $1.7 million in 2025 as the city marks years of growth fueled by local business and community investment.

item.title: Black and Jewish students at FSU and FAMU unite at dinner to fight hate on college campuses
item.description: The "Unity Dinner" brought Black and Jewish students together to create a space for open dialogue, shared stories, and conversations about combating antisemitism and anti-Black racism on campus.
